g.text: 24 paired comparisons / 3 confirmation guidelines; complete counterbalancing retained
Each colored arrow is one confirmation pair, from zero to the projected applicable-minus-inapplicable key difference.
Black: fitted shift. Purple: guideline-weighted confirmation mean. Common true scale and equal aspect; no arrow magnification.

g.text: Axes are head-specific and fitted only on fitting guidelines. Same-direction fractions use the full fitted shift.
